moments.author: Jensen Huang
moments.quote: If the Board decides my return is in the best interest … I would be honored to answer these calls and return as CEO.
moments.why: His possible return to lead Nvidia amid intense public and investor pressure is dominating discourse.

moments.author: Donald Trump
moments.quote: "Save Jensen!" in support of efforts to reinstate Huang as Nvidia CEO.
moments.why: A former president’s public endorsement amplifies the Nvidia leadership saga across politics and tech.

moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.quote: "I'm signing it too" referring to petition to reinstate Jensen Huang.
moments.why: Musk’s participation supercharges the reinstatement movement within tech circles.

moments.author: Various (via Techmeme quotes)
moments.quote: Jensen thanks everyone for support, owns his mistakes, will return if board invites him.
moments.why: Tech influencers and investors framing the narrative around his comeback are fueling the conversation.
